description: Flora-Bama's Ole River Grill is the ultimate family fun restaurant in Orange Beach. With a beautiful waterfront view and fantastic seafood, burgers, po-boys and desserts the grill has something for almost everyone. We have large outdoor decks and plenty of big screens for the sports fans. Come enjoy a meal, a cocktail or just pull up in your boat and relax on our beach.
atmosphere: Casual dining, waterfront, open-air deck, sports bar with large outdoor decks and big screens

contact.address: 17400 Perdido Key Drive, Perdido Key, FL 32507

policies.cancellation_policy: We do not take reservations or call ahead for seating, as all of our restaurants are casual dining, first-come, first-serve restaurants.
